I ventured too far from home again. This part of the city… {{wi}}I don’t like it.
Somehow it’s even worse than where I live. 
Surveillance cameras that are almost everywhere these days, here are being regularly destroyed by spray painting their lenses or just hitting them with a hard object till they are completely destroyed, which is even more scary, because they seem pretty sturdy.
??? 1: Hahaha! Get that you fucking bum!
??? 2: Don’t overdo it Josh, you might actually kill him, lmao!
??? 3: Totes~ 
T-this doesn’t sound too good. What’s going on there? Is someone getting beaten further into this tunnel?
Should I call the police?
Damn! There’s no signal…
Should I go back home and forget about it or maybe try to intervene?
